ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface area with high-intensity (white/off-white) localized at distal lateral tips; estimated 85:15 ratio of dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white mottled patch on the distal 20% of the left lobe; smaller, fragmented white patch on the distal 10% of the right lobe; central and medial regions consist of solid low-intensity pixels with sparse high-contrast micro-spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the trailing edge, with more pronounced, jagged topography at the distal tips where barnacle clusters disrupt the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with convex outer margins transitioning to a smooth concave trajectory leading into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of raised, high-contrast, multi-tonal brown/white pixels (barnacle colonies) at the extreme outer edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical, high-contrast white linear disruptions visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal fluke tips; multiple circular white cicatrices (scars) scattered across the dark pigmentation of the inner lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity specular highlights from water spray/droplets occluding pixel data on the right lobe and central fluke area.
